_comment: Three Grafana panels to paste into copy-detail.json (or any dashboard with datasource uid 'fleet-postgres'). IDs 70/71/72 are unused in copy-detail.json as of 2026-05-30. Adjust gridPos.y to fit your dashboard.

panels.title: Cluster detections — N_unique under dedup-hours hypotheses (last 30d)
panels.description: Per-row: a hypothesized COPY_CLUSTER_DEDUP_HOURS value, and the N_unique buckets it would have produced ON THE SAME RAW DETECTIONS. unique_pct = N_unique / N_total. Statistician's ship rule: do NOT ship exit redesign on a dataset where unique_pct < 50%.

targets.rawSql: WITH hypotheses(dedup_hours) AS (VALUES (1), (4), (12), (24), (72)), src AS (SELECT chain, token_mint, signal_type, direction, detected_at FROM cluster_detections WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM src) SELECT h.dedup_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT (s.chain, s.token_mint, s.signal_type, s.direction, date_bin(make_interval(hours => h.dedup_hours), s.detected_at, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'))) AS n_unique, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT (s.chain, s.token_mint, s.signal_type, s.direction, date_bin(make_interval(hours => h.dedup_hours), s.detected_at, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00')))::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT n FROM total), 0)::numeric, 1) AS unique_pct FROM hypotheses h, src s GROUP BY h.dedup_hours ORDER BY h.dedup_hours

panels.title: Cluster detections — fired vs suppressed per day (last 30d)
panels.description: Daily count of fired (passed dedup) vs suppressed (re-detected within the dedup_hours window) cluster events. A high suppressed/fired ratio means the bot is re-detecting the same setups repeatedly — confirming the data-independence problem the 2026-05-30 brainstorm identified.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', detected_at) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fired) AS fired, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT fired) AS suppressed FROM cluster_detections WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top tokens by re-detection (suppressed within dedup window)
panels.description: Tokens with the most cluster-detection re-fires within their dedup_hours window. Token mints showing many repeats are the ones inflating the apparent signal count — exactly what the 2026-05-30 diagnostic surfaced (7m96tz fired 6x).

targets.rawSql: SELECT token_mint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fired) AS n_fired, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT fired) AS n_suppressed, MIN(detected_at) AS first_seen, MAX(detected_at) AS last_seen FROM cluster_detections WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY token_mint HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY n_suppressed DESC, n_fired DESC LIMIT 20
